# ZingHR | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Large distributed enterprise HCM | A large distributed enterprise, HCM, is validated on the main link with “personnel or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| India/MEA/SEA multinational remuneration | The Indian/MEA/SEA multi-country remuneration is validated on the main link “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| High recruitment | High-level recruitment is validated on the basis of the main link, “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Manufacturing and retail front-line workers | The main link to validate manufacturing and retail front-line employees is “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
